Your first visit

Three steps from booking to a finished style.

First visit guide

  1. Book a time

    Choose your service on Booksy, or send a request and Abla will personally reach out within 24 hours.

  2. Prepare your hair

    Come with clean, detangled, completely dry hair. Skip heavy oils and products.

  3. Sit back and relax

    Settle into the private suite. Free parking, Wi-Fi and good conversation come with it.

Visit the studio

A private suite inside Sola Salon Studios, so it is calm, comfortable and all yours.
